features.feature: Implement the CLI-side Verification Context Pack protocol for the authority/evidence flow
Expose command entrypoints for verification_context_pack_create and verification_context_pack_expand
Bind verification context pack identifiers and refs into evidence envelopes
Add regression coverage for pack generation, expansion, digest, evidence binding, handler wiring, and command ownership
verification_context_pack_create mechanically generates a pack from git diff without writing story metadata, including tracked changes and untracked new files
digestVerificationContextPack provides stable canonical digest parity with the Python VerificationContextPack digest

Context pack contains auditable refs and boundaries: changed files, hunks, symbols, snippets, checklist/test/oracle/required-command refs, risk tags, limitations, token budget, truncated flag, and parent digest when applicable
verification_context_pack_expand requires expansionReason and forms a parent-linked pack chain with parentPackDigest
buildTargetBoundEvidenceEnvelope and EvidenceCollector populate coveredRefs, inspectedPackRefs, verificationContextPackId, and verificationContextPackDigest
New context-pack commands are command-policy safe: read-only, all phases, and non-destructive
CLI-side verification commands include build, test:verification-context-pack, and test:command-ownership-contract
Truth source documentation records CLI/server responsibilities, test commands, maintenance rules, and NAV discoverability
Authority/context-pack changes stay under the current Koala story flow, worktree, verificationIntent, verificationEvidence, and koala validate discipline
Python authority server signs verifier jobs and validates server-issued pack id, digest, producerRunId, and diffHash
